kits.name: AAA (HS / GC / AM house style)
kits.description: House kit for AAA Home Specialists, AAA Graphic Co and Avant Movers: deep navy, safety orange accent, bold condensed display type. Colors are placeholders until aaaBrandDNA.md is applied.
kits.source: business/GC/graphicCo/aaaBrandDNA.md (on aaalpha; not read in this session)

kits.name: AAA Graphic Co: Studio
kits.description: Creative-studio variant for AAA Graphic Co: near-black on white, electric violet primary, the family orange as accent, Syne display, DM Sans body, 12px radii, playful hover lifts.

kits.name: AAA Home Specialists: Bold
kits.description: Heavier AAA Home Specialists variant: safety orange primary on white with black #0a0a0a sections, Oswald condensed display, Barlow body, tight radii, high contrast.

kits.name: Ant Design
kits.description: Ant Design 5: system stack, daybreak blue #1677ff, 6px radius, compact spacing, light #d9d9d9 borders, white default buttons.

kits.name: Apple HIG
kits.description: Apple Human Interface Guidelines on the web: SF-like system stack, system blue, hairline borders, tight large headings, pill buttons.

kits.name: Atlassian Design System
kits.description: Atlassian Design System: brand blue #0C66E4, N800 #172B4D text, 3px radius, Charlie-like sans falling back to system, lozenge badges, 2px-border fields, dark surfaces #1D2125.

kits.name: Base (neutral)
kits.description: The contract defaults. Clean, neutral, system fonts. Every component must look finished here.

kits.name: Bauhaus
kits.description: Primary red, blue and yellow on cream and black. Geometric Jost type, chunky 3px borders, tricolor card stripes, zero radius.

kits.name: Bootstrap 5
kits.description: Bootstrap 5.3: system stack, primary #0d6efd, the classic secondary/success/warning/danger set, 6px radius, medium-weight headings, 5.3 dark mode.

kits.name: IBM Carbon
kits.description: IBM Carbon: IBM Plex Sans and Mono, Blue 60, zero border radius, dense spacing, left-aligned buttons, Gray 100 dark theme.

kits.name: Catppuccin Mocha
kits.description: The Catppuccin Mocha pastel-on-dark palette: base #1e1e2e, mauve primary, peach accent, soft rounded corners. Inter and JetBrains Mono.

kits.name: Chakra UI
kits.description: Chakra UI: Inter, teal color scheme, gray.50-900 scale, 6px radii, semibold buttons, uppercase badges, blue focus ring.

kits.name: Cyberpunk Neon
kits.description: Night-city neon: #0a0a12 background, cyan primary, magenta and yellow accents, clipped button corners, glow shadows, Orbitron display with Rajdhani body.

kits.name: DaisyUI Cupcake
kits.description: DaisyUI 'cupcake' playfulness: cream base, pastel teal primary with dark text, pink secondary, honey accent, pill buttons, big rounded boxes; Dracula-flavored dark scheme.

kits.name: Dracula
kits.description: The Dracula editor theme as a site: #282a36 background, #f8f8f2 foreground, purple primary, pink accent, green success, cyan links. Fira Sans and Fira Code.

kits.name: Microsoft Fluent 2
kits.description: Microsoft Fluent 2: Segoe UI, brand blue #0F6CBD, neutral grays, 4-8px radii, layered soft shadows, bottom-border inputs.

kits.name: Glassmorphism
kits.description: Frosted glass over a violet-to-cyan gradient: translucent blurred cards with white hairline borders, 20px radii, Poppins. Light pastel and deep-violet dark schemes.

kits.name: Gruvbox
kits.description: Retro groove: warm #fbf1c7 light scheme with orange primary and blue accent, #282828 dark scheme. Source Serif 4 headings over Source Sans 3 body.

kits.name: Mantine
kits.description: Mantine v7: Inter-ish type, blue #228be6, gray.0-3 surfaces, 8px radius, 600-weight buttons, uppercase pill badges, dark.7 dark scheme.

kits.name: Material Design 3
kits.description: Google's Material You system: baseline tonal palette, surface tints instead of heavy shadows, pill buttons, large radii, Roboto.

kits.name: Neo-Brutalism
kits.description: Stark cream and white, 3px black borders, hard offset shadows, acid yellow and hot pink. Archivo Black headlines, Space Grotesk body, zero radius.

kits.name: NES 8-bit
kits.description: NES.css flavored 8-bit: Press Start 2P headlines, system mono body, 4px black borders, pixel-step box-shadows, red/blue/green game-cartridge colors, zero radius.

kits.name: Nord
kits.description: Arctic, bluish Nord palette: Snow Storm light scheme with Frost blue primary and Aurora green accent, Polar Night dark scheme. Rubik type.

kits.name: Paper / Newsprint
kits.description: Broadsheet newspaper: off-white stock, near-black ink, one dark-red accent, Playfair Display mastheads over Libre Baskerville body, double rules, no radius, no shadows.

kits.name: Shopify Polaris
kits.description: Shopify Polaris admin feel: Inter, green #008060 primary, interactive blue accent, white cards on soft gray, 8px radius, inset button shadows.

kits.name: GitHub Primer
kits.description: GitHub Primer: system stack, accent blue #0969da, green primary buttons, canvas white on subtle gray, 1px #d0d7de borders, 6px radius, #0d1117 dark.

kits.name: Radix Themes
kits.description: Radix Themes feel: Inter, indigo accent, slate grays, 6px radius, soft panel shadows, solid/outline/soft button variants.

kits.name: Swiss / International Style
kits.description: International Typographic Style: white, black, one red. Inter/Helvetica, huge tight headlines, strict grid, thin rules, zero radius, no shadows.

kits.name: Tailwind / shadcn/ui
kits.description: shadcn/ui default theme: Inter, zinc neutrals, near-black primary, 6-8px radii, 1px borders, monochrome accents.

kits.name: Terminal Green
kits.description: Green phosphor CRT: near-black background, #33ff66 text, dim green rules, monospace everything, scanlines, buttons that invert on hover.

kits.name: Vaporwave
kits.description: A E S T H E T I C: pastel pink, cyan, purple and yellow, perspective-grid background, Monoton neon h1, VT323 pixel headings, Inter body. Sunset dark scheme.

kits.name: Windows 98
kits.description: Classic Windows 98 chrome: #c0c0c0 faces, navy title bars, beveled outset and inset borders, zero radius, no shadows, MS Sans Serif stack.

kits.name: Windows XP (Luna)
kits.description: Luna blue: navy-to-blue gradient buttons, green start-button accent, 3px radii, light bluish surfaces, Tahoma and Trebuchet.

kits.name: Y2K Chrome
kits.description: Millennium gloss: silver chrome gradients, electric blue and lime, bubbly pill buttons with glossy highlights, Audiowide display and Exo 2 body.

components.name: About: letter from the owner
components.description: Narrow letter-style note from the owner on a paper-like card: greeting, three short paragraphs, cursive signature line, name and title, small portrait.

components.name: About: split story
components.description: Job-site photo on the left, company story with three checkmark bullets and a button on the right. Photo stacks on top on mobile.

components.name: About: company history
components.description: Year milestones alternating left and right of a center line on desktop; single left-aligned column with the line on mobile.

components.name: About: mission and values
components.description: Mission statement on the left, four value cards with icons on the right in a two-by-two grid. Stacks to one column on phones.

components.name: Blog: three post cards
components.description: Section heading with a View all link, then three post cards: image, category badge, title, excerpt, date and read time.

components.name: Blog: category chips and grid
components.description: A row of category chip links (one marked current) above a four-card post grid. Static links; pair with a CMS or the filterable gallery for live filtering.

components.name: Blog: featured post plus list
components.description: One large featured post with image, badge, title, excerpt and author on the left; three compact posts with small thumbnails stacked on the right.

components.name: Blog: horizontal list rows
components.description: Four post rows, each with a thumbnail on the left and category, title, excerpt and meta on the right. Divider lines between rows; thumbnails shrink on phones.

components.name: Blog: single post article
components.description: Full article layout: category, title, author and date meta, lead paragraph, hero image, body with h3 headings, a list, a pull quote, and a share row with tags at the end.

components.name: Commerce: cart summary
components.description: Three line items with thumbnail, variant, quantity stepper, price and remove button; totals card with promo code field and checkout button.

components.name: Commerce: category tiles
components.description: Four linked image tiles with a dark gradient and the category name and item count in the corner. Two across on tablet, one on phones.

components.name: Commerce: checkout form
components.description: Contact, shipping address and delivery method fields with a payment placeholder (no card inputs; connect Stripe or Square) beside a sticky order summary.

components.name: Commerce: featured product split
components.description: Large product photo on one side; staff-pick eyebrow, name, price, blurb, three selling points and Add to cart on the other. Image moves on top on mobile.

components.name: Commerce: product detail
components.description: Image gallery with four thumbnails that switch the main photo (radio inputs, no JS), plus title, price, rating, size select, quantity and Add to cart. Details list below.

components.name: Commerce: product grid
components.description: Heading with a view-all link and six product cards: square image, optional badge, name, one-line blurb, price and an Add to cart button.

components.name: Commerce: reviews list
components.description: Rating summary with a five-to-one star breakdown (bar widths from a custom property) beside three customer reviews with avatar, stars, date and verified badge.

components.name: Commerce: sale banner
components.description: Full-width primary-color band with eyebrow, sale headline, promo code chip and a shop button. Tight vertical padding so it slots between sections.

components.name: Commerce: trust badges row
components.description: Four icon-and-text reassurances on a surface band: free shipping, easy returns, secure checkout, local pickup. Two across on tablet, stacked on phones.

components.name: Contact: three cards (call, email, visit)
components.description: Centered heading over three equal cards with an icon, label, the contact value and a button each: call, email, visit.

components.name: Contact: full-width call CTA
components.description: Primary-colored band with a big headline, a large phone number link, a short promise and a secondary button. Centered, stacks on mobile.

components.name: Contact: hours table
components.description: Heading and holiday note on the left; a seven-row hours table on the right with today's row highlighted by a class, closed days muted, and an emergency line under it.

components.name: Contact: map on top, form below
components.description: Edge-to-edge map placeholder (data-wf-embed) with a floating address chip, then a two-column block below: short contact details on the left and a message form on the right.

components.name: Contact: form with info cards
components.description: Contact form on the left; three stacked info cards (call, email, visit) with icons on the right, plus hours. Stacks on mobile with the cards first.

components.name: Content: accordion text blocks
components.description: Heading and intro on the left, four expandable text sections on the right built on native details/summary with a rotating chevron. Script keeps one section open at a time; without it, all sections still work.

components.name: Content: checklist in columns
components.description: Heading on the left, two titled checklists on the right (what is included / what to have ready) with check icons. A footnote sits under the lists.

components.name: Content: rich text prose
components.description: Article-width rich text sample with h2, h3s, paragraphs, an unordered list, an ordered list, a blockquote, inline links and a small note. Use as a starting block for any long-form page.

components.name: Content: large quote block
components.description: A single large pull quote on a surface background with an oversized opening mark, attribution with avatar, and a short context line. Works as a testimonial or an owner statement.

components.name: Content: three tabs
components.description: Three tabs (Repairs, Remodels, Maintenance plans) switching between text panels with a small list and a link each. Full WAI-ARIA tabs pattern: arrow keys, Home/End, roving tabindex. All panels show stacked without JS.

components.name: Content: year timeline
components.description: Vertical timeline of five milestones, each with a year marker on the line, a title and a sentence. Alternates sides on desktop, single column on mobile.

components.name: Content: two-column text
components.description: A heading and lead spanning the top, then two columns of body text with their own h3s, divided by a vertical rule. Columns stack on tablet and below.

components.name: CTA: app badges
components.description: Promote a mobile app or booking link: headline, text and two dark store-style badge buttons (App Store, Google Play) drawn with inline icons, next to a phone-frame screenshot.

components.name: CTA: band
components.description: One-line primary-colored band: a short headline and supporting line on the left, one accent button on the right. Stacks and centers on phones.

components.name: CTA: floating card
components.description: A shadowed white card that overlaps the bottom edge of its primary-colored band and hangs into the next section. Headline and text on the left, two buttons on the right. Place it directly above any section.

components.name: CTA: newsletter
components.description: Centered headline and short pitch with an inline email field and subscribe button, plus a privacy line. Field and button stack on phones.

components.name: CTA: big phone number
components.description: Dark section with a giant tappable phone number, a 'Call or text' prompt above it, hours beneath and a secondary online-quote link. The number scales with the viewport.

components.name: CTA: split with image
components.description: Rounded two-column card on a surface background: image on the left, eyebrow, headline, text and two buttons on the right. Image stacks on top on mobile.

components.name: Element: accordion
components.description: Stack of collapsible panels; opening one closes the others. Headers are real buttons with aria-expanded; arrow keys move between headers.

components.name: Element: alert
components.description: Four alert boxes (info, success, warning, danger) switched by modifier class. Icon, title, message; left accent bar and a tinted background.

components.name: Element: avatar group
components.description: Four overlapping avatars, a +count bubble, and a trust line with a star rating. Use near a CTA as social proof.

components.name: Element: badge set
components.description: Base, primary and accent badges plus tinted success/warning/danger/info variants and a status-dot badge.

components.name: Element: breadcrumb
components.description: Home icon, two ancestor links and the current page, separated by chevrons. Wraps on narrow screens.

components.name: Element: segmented button group
components.description: Three-way segmented control built on radio inputs so it toggles without JavaScript. Keyboard navigable with arrow keys.

components.name: Element: button with icon
components.description: Buttons with a leading icon (phone, calendar, mail) plus one with a trailing arrow. Icons inherit the button color.

components.name: Element: button palette
components.description: Every .wf-btn variant (primary, secondary, accent, outline, ghost), the three sizes, and a full-width button, laid out as a palette.

components.name: Element: basic card
components.description: Plain .wf-card with eyebrow, title, short paragraph and a text link. The simplest building block for lists and grids.

components.name: Element: horizontal card
components.description: Image on the left, copy and link on the right. Stacks with the image on top below 600px.

components.name: Element: icon card
components.description: Card with an icon in a tinted circle, a title and a short description. The standard feature or service tile.

components.name: Element: card with image on top
components.description: Card with a 3:2 image bleeding to the edges, a badge, title, blurb and a button. Good for services and blog teasers.

components.name: Element: countdown timer
components.description: Days, hours, minutes and seconds until the date in data-wf-date on the root. Shows an 'ended' message once the date passes.

components.name: Element: divider with text
components.description: Horizontal rule with a short label in the middle, plus a second variant with a small icon. For breaking up long pages or forms.

components.name: Element: dropdown menu
components.description: Button that toggles a menu of links. Closes on outside click or Escape; arrow keys move through items, Home and End jump.

components.name: Element: icon lists
components.description: Three list styles side by side: green check marks, primary arrows and accent bolts. Each list is its own block you can drop anywhere.

components.name: Element: modal dialog
components.description: Trigger button that opens a centered dialog over a dimmed overlay. Focus is trapped inside, Escape or the backdrop closes, focus returns to the trigger.

components.name: Element: pagination
components.description: Previous and next buttons around numbered pages with an ellipsis; the current page is marked with aria-current.

components.name: Element: progress bars
components.description: Three labeled progress bars with percentage readouts. Fill width comes from a --c-el-progress-bar-value custom property on each bar.

components.name: Element: rating stars
components.description: A static 4.5-star display with review count, and an interactive star picker (radiogroup) that works with click and arrow keys and writes to a hidden input.

components.name: Element: striped table
components.description: Zebra-striped price table with a caption, sticky-feeling header row and a horizontal scroll wrapper for phones.

components.name: Element: tabs
components.description: Three tabs with panels. Click or use arrow keys, Home and End to move between tabs; the active panel is the only one shown.

components.name: Element: toast notification
components.description: Button that fires a bottom-corner toast inside an aria-live region. Auto-hides after four seconds or on the close button; repeat clicks reset the timer.

components.name: Element: tooltip
components.description: CSS-only tooltips that appear on hover and keyboard focus, above and below the trigger. Linked with aria-describedby.

components.name: FAQ: accordion
components.description: Six questions in a single-column accordion. Buttons toggle aria-expanded and the panel's hidden state; script re-keys ids so several copies can share a page.

components.name: FAQ: searchable accordion
components.description: Search box above an accordion. Typing filters questions live, shows a result count, auto-opens matches and offers a reset. Works with no script as a plain accordion list.

components.name: FAQ: two columns, static
components.description: Eight short question and answer pairs laid out in two columns with no interaction. Good for print-style clarity; one column on phones.

components.name: FAQ: accordion with contact card
components.description: Accordion on the left, sticky "Still have questions?" card on the right with phone, email and hours. Card drops below the list on mobile.

components.name: Features: alternating rows
components.description: Three image-and-text rows that alternate sides on desktop (image left, right, left). Each row has an eyebrow, title, paragraph and text link. Images stack above text on mobile.

components.name: Features: bento grid
components.description: Asymmetric five-cell grid: one large image-backed cell, a tall stat cell, two medium text cells and a wide dark CTA cell. Reflows to two columns on tablet and one on phone.

components.name: Features: hover cards
components.description: Four linked cards with icon, title, text and an arrow. Cards lift and gain a shadow and primary border on hover. Two columns on tablet, one on phone.

components.name: Features: checklist
components.description: Headline, lead and button on the left; a two-column list of eight checked items on the right. List collapses to one column on phones.

components.name: Features: us vs. them
components.description: Two side-by-side columns comparing the typical contractor experience (muted, crossed items) with yours (highlighted, checked items). Stacks on mobile.

components.name: Features: icon grid
components.description: Centered eyebrow, headline and lead above a 3x2 grid of icon, title and short text. Two columns on tablet, one on phone.

components.name: Features: tabs
components.description: Three tabs (Repairs, Remodels, Smart home) switch a panel with image, title, text and a link. Arrow keys move between tabs; proper tablist roles.

components.name: Footer: centered
components.description: Everything centered: business name, a row of six links, three social icons, a contact line and the copyright. Light surface background.

components.name: Footer: four columns
components.description: Brand blurb, two link columns, contact column; copyright bar.

components.name: Footer: CTA card above
components.description: A big primary-colored CTA card overlaps the top of a dark four-column footer. Card has headline, text and two buttons; footer has brand, links, contact and a copyright bar.

components.name: Footer: mega with newsletter
components.description: Dark footer with a newsletter row on top, then five columns (brand and hours, Services, Company, Service area, Contact) and a bottom bar with social icons and legal links.

components.name: Footer: simple line
components.description: One-line footer on a light surface: business name left, four links in the middle, copyright right. Wraps to centered rows on phones.

components.name: Form: book an appointment
components.description: Appointment request with date, time-slot select, service, contact details and notes, next to a card listing availability and a phone fallback.

components.name: Form: request a callback
components.description: Dark band with a short promise on the left and a two-field callback form (phone, best time) on the right. Good above a footer.

components.name: Form: basic contact
components.description: Centered contact form with name, email, phone and message, plus a short reassurance line under the submit button.

components.name: Form: instant estimate calculator
components.description: Square footage times a per-foot rate from a service select, with a live total rounded up to the nearest $10. Submit requests a firm quote.

components.name: Form: login / sign up tabs
components.description: Centered card with two tabs: sign in (email, password, remember me) and create account (name, email, password, consent). Tabs switch panels; arrow keys move between tabs.

components.name: Form: three-step wizard
components.description: Three-step project request (job, home, contact) with a progress bar, next/back buttons and per-step validation. Client-side only; the final step submits the whole form.

components.name: Form: inline newsletter
components.description: Compact band with a headline on the left and a single-line email signup on the right. Consent note under the field.

components.name: Form: quote request
components.description: Two-column quote request: service select, address, preferred date, photo upload, description and budget range. Sidebar explains what happens next.

components.name: Gallery: before / after slider
components.description: Two stacked images with a draggable divider revealing the before shot. Pointer events, keyboard arrows (Home/End to jump), labels and a caption. Falls back to a 50/50 split without JS.

components.name: Gallery: scroll-snap carousel
components.description: Horizontal strip of project cards with CSS scroll-snap. Previous/next arrows scroll one card at a time and disable at the ends; the strip also scrolls by touch or trackpad without JS.

components.name: Gallery: filterable by category
components.description: Filter buttons (All, Kitchens, Baths, Exterior, Repairs) above a grid of eight projects tagged with data-category. Buttons toggle aria-pressed and hide non-matching cards; a count line updates.

components.name: Gallery: 3x3 grid with captions
components.description: Nine square project photos in a three-column grid, each with a caption and location line. Two columns on tablet, one on phone.

components.name: Gallery: grid with lightbox
components.description: Six thumbnails; clicking any opens a full-screen overlay with the large image, caption, previous/next arrows, a counter and a close button. Escape and arrow keys work, focus returns on close.

components.name: Gallery: masonry columns
components.description: Mixed-height project photos flowing through CSS multi-columns (3 / 2 / 1). Hover reveals a short caption.

components.name: Gallery: video thumbnails grid
components.description: Three video cards with a poster image, play badge, duration chip and a short description. Each card carries data-wf-embed for the host to wire a video URL; nothing is hotlinked.

components.name: Hero: carousel
components.description: Three full-width slides, each with its own image, overlay, headline and button. Dots and arrows switch slides; keyboard arrows work. Autoplays every 7 seconds only when reduced motion is off, pausing on hover and focus.

components.name: Hero: centered on background image
components.description: Full-bleed background image with a dark overlay, centered eyebrow, headline, lead and two buttons. Minimum height scales with the viewport.

components.name: Hero: emergency bar
components.description: Service-business hero with a 24/7 phone strip across the top, headline, lead and two buttons, then a row of four trust badges (licensed, same-day, rated, warranty).

components.name: Hero: quote form right
components.description: Headline, lead and three trust points on the left; a four-field quote-request card (name, phone, service, details) on the right. Form stacks under the copy on mobile.

components.name: Hero: gradient headline
components.description: App-style centered hero: pill badge, headline with a primary-to-accent gradient clipped to the text, lead, two buttons and a framed product screenshot underneath.

components.name: Hero: minimal left
components.description: One oversized headline, one supporting line and one button, left-aligned with generous whitespace. No image, no clutter.

components.name: Hero: pricing teaser
components.description: Headline and lead with three starting-price chips and a button on the left; a highlighted 'most booked' package card with a bullet list on the right.

components.name: Hero: split with image
components.description: Eyebrow, headline, lead, two buttons and a trust line on the left; framed image on the right. Stacks on mobile.

components.name: Hero: split with stats
components.description: Headline, lead and button on the left with three big numbers beneath them; framed image on the right. Image moves above the copy on mobile.

components.name: Hero: video background
components.description: Muted, looping, autoplaying background video with a poster placeholder and dark overlay; headline, lead and buttons sit left-aligned on top. Swap the source for your own clip.

components.name: Logos: bordered grid
components.description: Six wordmarks in a three-by-two grid of hairline-bordered cells with a heading on the left. Three columns on tablet, two on phone.

components.name: Logos: scrolling marquee
components.description: Six wordmarks scrolling endlessly with CSS keyframes only; the track is duplicated for a seamless loop. Pauses on hover and stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Logos: single row
components.description: Caption plus six placeholder partner wordmarks as inline SVG in one muted row. Wraps to two and three rows on smaller screens.

components.name: Media: four-image mosaic
components.description: Heading and intro on the left, a 2x2 mosaic of photos on the right with one tall image spanning two rows. Collapses to a two-column grid on mobile.

components.name: Media: image and text split
components.description: Large image on the left with a small stat badge overlapping its corner; eyebrow, heading, two paragraphs, a checklist and a button on the right. Image stacks on top on mobile.

components.name: Media: map with address card
components.description: Map placeholder box (data-wf-embed for the host to swap in a map) beside an address card with hours, phone and an Open in Google Maps link. Stacks on mobile.

components.name: Media: responsive video embed
components.description: 16:9 video frame with a local poster image and a play button. The wrapper carries data-wf-embed for the host to swap in an iframe URL; nothing external loads by default.

components.name: Nav: centered logo
components.description: Logo text centered with three links on the left and two links plus a phone button on the right. Collapses to a centered, wrapping link row on mobile.

components.name: Nav: mega menu
components.description: Logo, links and phone button; the Services item opens a three-column panel (Repairs, Remodels, Smart home) with a featured callout. Closes on outside click or Escape. Hamburger below 900px.

components.name: Nav: minimal pill
components.description: A floating rounded pill centered at the top of the page: logo text, four links and a small button, with a blurred translucent background. Links scroll horizontally on narrow screens.

components.name: Nav: sidebar drawer
components.description: Hamburger at every width. Tapping it slides a drawer in from the left with links, hours and contact details, behind a dimmed backdrop. Escape or backdrop click closes it.

components.name: Nav: simple with CTA
components.description: Logo text left, five links, phone button right. Hamburger below 900px.

components.name: Nav: top bar with contact
components.description: Thin dark top bar with phone, hours, city and social icons; main nav below with logo text, five links and an estimate button. Links wrap on mobile; hours hide below 600px.

components.name: Nav: transparent overlay
components.description: Absolutely positioned over the hero with white text on a soft black gradient; becomes a fixed solid bar once the page scrolls. Hamburger menu below 900px.

components.name: Pricing: service menu
components.description: Handyman-style price list in two groups (rates and common jobs) with dotted leaders. Round, scannable numbers and a quote button.

components.name: Pricing: single offer card
components.description: One centered offer: price, short pitch, bullet list of what is included, button and fine print.

components.name: Pricing: comparison table
components.description: Feature matrix with three plan columns, check and dash icons, and a button row. Collapses to stacked labelled rows below 768px.

components.name: Pricing: three tiers
components.description: Three plan cards with price, feature list and button; the middle card is lifted and badged "Most popular". Stacks on mobile.

components.name: Pricing: monthly / yearly toggle
components.description: Three maintenance plans with a segmented monthly/yearly switch. Script swaps amounts from data attributes; yearly shows the savings badge.

components.name: Process: before, during, after
components.description: Three phase panels for a remodel job, each with a photo, phase label, title and a short checklist. One column on phones.

components.name: Process: cards with arrows
components.description: Three icon cards linked by arrow icons that point right on desktop and down when the cards stack on mobile.

components.name: Process: four steps in a row
components.description: Four numbered steps joined by a connecting line, each with title and two lines of copy. Becomes a two-by-two grid on tablet and a numbered column on phone.

components.name: Process: vertical timeline
components.description: Five milestones on a vertical line with dots, each with a day label, title and copy. Narrow column, reads top to bottom on every screen.

components.name: Services: accordion
components.description: Five expandable service rows. Each header button shows the name and starting price; the panel reveals details, a bullet list and a quote link. One open at a time; the first opens by default.

components.name: Services: service area
components.description: Where-we-work section: a simple inline SVG map placeholder with town markers, beside two lists, the regular service area (Russellville, Dardanelle, London, Atkins, Pottsville, Danville, Hector) and travel-by-appointment cities (NWA, Little Rock, Fort Smith).

components.name: Services: card grid
components.description: Six service cards in a three-column grid, each with an icon, title, two-line description and a 'Learn more' link. Two columns on tablet, one on phone.

components.name: Services: icon row
components.description: A compact row of four circular icons with captions and one-line descriptions, each linking to the services page. Wraps to two per row on phones.

components.name: Services: list with prices
components.description: Stacked service rows, each with a title, one-line description, a 'from $X' starting price and a book button. Prices are round numbers; the footnote explains what 'from' means.

components.name: Services: split with image
components.description: Framed image on the left; eyebrow, headline, lead, a two-column checked list of eight services and a button on the right. Stacks on mobile with the image first.

components.name: Stats: animated counters
components.description: Three numbers that count up from zero when scrolled into view (IntersectionObserver). Honors prefers-reduced-motion and shows final values with no script.

components.name: Stats: dark band
components.description: Full-width band on the secondary color with a short line of copy and three large stats in accent color. Stacks on phones.

components.name: Stats: four-up row
components.description: Four big numbers with labels in a single row, divided by hairlines. Two-by-two on tablet and phone.

components.name: Stats: beside image
components.description: Headline and a two-by-two block of stats on the left, framed job-site photo on the right. Image stacks on top on mobile.

components.name: Stats: with icons
components.description: Four stat tiles, each with a tinted icon badge, a big number and a one-line explanation. Two-by-two on tablet, single column on phone.

components.name: Team: cards with social links
components.description: Three member cards with photo, name, role, short bio and a row of icon links (email, phone, Facebook, Instagram).

components.name: Team: four-up grid
components.description: Four team members with square photo, name, role and one line each. Two columns on tablet, one on phone.

components.name: Team: we're hiring
components.description: Recruiting band: headline, three reasons to join, two open roles with pay and a button to apply. Dark band on the secondary color.

components.name: Team: compact list
components.description: Six staff rows with small round photo, name, role, specialty and a direct email link. Tight enough for a sidebar or an about page.

components.name: Team: founder story
components.description: Owner portrait on one side, origin story, three quick facts and a signature on the other. Photo stacks on top on mobile.

components.name: Testimonials: review platform cards
components.description: Rating summary header (4.9, 180 reviews, five stars) above three platform-style review cards with initial avatars, dates and a source line.

components.name: Testimonials: three cards
components.description: Three review cards with five-star rating, quote, name and town. Two columns on tablet, one on phone.

components.name: Testimonials: masonry wall
components.description: Six reviews of varied length flowing into three CSS columns, masonry style. Two columns on tablet, one on phone.

components.name: Testimonials: single large quote
components.description: One big pull quote with a customer photo, stars, name and town. Photo moves above the quote on mobile.

components.name: Testimonials: slider
components.description: One review at a time with previous/next buttons and dot indicators. Keyboard friendly, announces changes, works with several copies per page.

components.name: Testimonials: video cards
components.description: Three video-testimonial cards: poster image with play button, duration badge, one-line pull quote, name and town. Links point to the video page.

components.name: Utility: 404 block
components.description: Oversized 404, a friendly headline, a site search box and quick links to the pages people actually want, plus the phone number.

components.name: Utility: announcement bar
components.description: Slim bar for the top of the page with an icon, a short message, a link and a close button. Dismissal is remembered for the session.

components.name: Utility: back to top
components.description: Round button pinned to the bottom-right corner that fades in after scrolling 400px and smooth-scrolls to the top (instant when reduced motion is on).

components.name: Utility: coming soon block
components.description: Launch page section: eyebrow, headline, live countdown to the date in data-wf-date, an email notify form and a phone line for the meantime.

components.name: Utility: cookie banner
components.description: Fixed bottom card with a short notice, privacy link, Accept and Decline buttons. The choice is remembered in localStorage so it only shows once.

components.name: Utility: maintenance block
components.description: Down-for-maintenance page section with an icon, headline, expected return time and phone/email contact cards so customers can still reach you.

components.name: Utility: social proof popup
components.description: Small bottom-left card that cycles through recent-activity lines ('Someone in Dardanelle requested a quote 12 min ago'). Closable, remembered for the session, and it stops cycling when reduced motion is on.
